description: Submit signed evidence to an open dispute. Claimant evidence must be signed by the payer key; respondent evidence additionally requires the seller API key (TERSIGN_LEDGER_API_KEY).

artifacts.description: at least one evidence reference; submit every artifact you want considered in a single call

at.description: unix seconds the artifact was produced; supply it when timing is part of your argument

digest.description: 0x-prefixed keccak256 digest of the artifact. Only the DIGEST is submitted — the content itself never leaves your side

kind.description: what this artifact is; the adjudicator treats each kind differently

note.description: short human-readable label for whoever reads the record; never an adjudication input

disputeDigest.description: 0x-prefixed digest of the open dispute, as returned by open_dispute

role.description: which side you are filing as: 'claimant' = the payer who opened it (payer key) · 'respondent' = the seller answering it (also needs TERSIGN_LEDGER_API_KEY)

name: submit_dispute_evidence
title: Submit dispute evidence
